items.html:
Whole non-autodiff API mapped through root exports, source-generated catalog, implementation modules, and representative public workflow tests.

Family Existing API Recommended destination
Materials Material, tuple/scalar coercion, from_n/from_nmp, index/impedance/wavenumber properties Keep material object; clear medium names wherever it represents exterior. Explicit polarization defaults.
Bases Spherical/cylindrical and two plane-wave basis classes; defaults, diffraction orders, selections/set operations, transforms SphericalBasis, CylindricalBasis, directional PlaneWaveBasis, transverse PlaneWavePorts; preserve mode selection and diffraction constructors.
Sources PlaneWave, MultipoleWave, plane/spherical/cylindrical constructors Keyword direction, polarization, k0, medium; typed wave results and in_basis(), explicit .coefficients.
Fields Six field kinds E/H/D/B/G/F, both weighted wave methods and operator matrices Preserve wave .efield() etc.; explicit matrix builders in operators.
Isolated scattering TMatrix.sphere, TMatrixC.cylinder, arbitrary matrix constructors Keyword sphere_tmatrix/cylinder_tmatrix; separate interior materials from exterior medium.
Finite clusters TMatrix.cluster, .interaction.solve/factor/illuminate Distinct unsolved Cluster; .solve() -> TMatrix, .scatter(incident) -> Wave, reusable factor explicitly retained.
Periodic scattering .latticeinteraction, implicit solve inside SMatrices.from_array and TMatrixC.from_array solve_periodic() -> PeriodicResponse; owns lattice/Bloch vector; .scatter(), .to_smatrix(), .to_cylindrical() never solve again.
T-matrix operations Array matmul; basis selection; rotation/expansion/polarization conversion; exclusion masks Typed .scatter(), .select(), .in_basis(), .rotate(), explicit polarization conversion. Keep .array escape hatch.
Observables xs/xw, abbreviated averaged properties and cd/db/chi Named cross-section/cross-width result; descriptive metric names, retain precise physical distinction between area/length.
Planar networks SMatrices whole network, SMatrix single block; interface/slab/propagation/add/stack/double SMatrix whole network, ScatteringBlock block; clear constructors and ordered .cascade()/stack().
Planar outputs illuminate() variable tuple; tr/cd; periodic/bands_kz; flux/chirality forms Named outgoing fields, power results, circular-dichroism results, transfer_matrix(), bands(period) with named wavenumbers/eigenvectors.
Operator machinery Matrix functions plus operator classes/descriptors/inversion Explicit operators namespace; do not require descriptor protocol for ordinary physical workflows.
Geometry Lattice, WaveVector, lattice constructors/transforms/set combinations Keep established geometry operations; use explicit bloch_vector terminology on periodic boundaries.
Numerical coefficients coeffs Mie/Fresnel; pw/cw/sw direct coefficients/conversions Preserve complete expert namespace functionality. Cosmetic renaming offers less benefit than workflow fixes.
Special functions Bessel/Hankel/Legendre/Wigner/gamma/Kambe, coordinate/vector transforms, scalar/vector waves and translation coefficients Preserve special as explicit numerical tools; no need to wrap everything in physics classes.
Lattice sums Ewald full/real/reciprocal/direct families in supported 1D/2D/3D, shifted geometries, expansion, cell geometry/diffraction orders Preserve complete lattice numerical namespace and context-bearing numerical paths.
Misc/EBCM Index and axial wavevector helpers, mode matching, polarization conversion, Brillouin folding; EBCM quadrature/Q-matrix Keep dedicated numerical namespaces; retain documented corrected-vs-legacy EBCM distinction.
Iterative solver iterative.SphereCluster, Solution, Convergence, recorded solve/gradient Preserve restricted vacuum/nonmagnetic contract and convergence reports; add typed source/result path without removing array batches.
I/O Optional HDF5 save/load including sweeps/metadata/unit handling; Gmsh spheres Preserve optional io; migrate loaded object types and keep roundtrip coverage.
Discovery/testing Catalog, module CLI, derivative checking helpers, mutable config.POLTYPE Preserve diagnostics and source-generated docs; replace global polarization default with explicit deterministic defaults.

Critical implementation constraints:

  • Reuse MultipoleWave: it already carries complete metadata and native weighted field evaluation.
  • It currently supports only vectors; factor/iterative paths support (modes, illuminations). Preserve that batch path.
  • Changing @ affects _cross_sections, which currently expects arrays.
  • Changing source .expand() affects _TMatrix._incident, S-matrix illumination, operators, and tests. Distinguish physical in_basis() from numerical coefficients.
  • Unsolved cluster T-matrices currently permit @, silently bypassing interaction. A distinct cluster object removes this invalid state.
  • Periodic response must remain distinct from isolated T-matrix: isolated cross sections are invalid.
  • S-matrix media order is currently opposite constructor layer order. Named negative/positive media remove a major surprise.
  • PlaneWave(kvec=...) normalizes its argument: the existing name incorrectly suggests physical wavevector magnitude.
  • Catalog discovery ignores pure imported aliases in public modules. Facade exports require catalog support changes.

No files changed; numerical tests not rerun.
